title: Constructive Lean 4 Kernel and Exact Zero-Float Certificates for OpenAI's Matching Matrix Multiplication Lower Bound omega_F = 9/4
abstract: A November 24, 2026 companion preprint from OpenAI proposes a matching lower bound showing that the matrix multiplication exponent equals omega_F = 9/4 over every field, with geometric border rank at least n^(9/4), at least ceil(n^(9/4)/2) nonscalar multiplication or division gates, dual exponent alpha_F <= 2/3, and refutation of Strassen's tight-tensor conjecture. Rather than assuming peer-reviewed validation of its CAT(0) spectral-space and tensor-network compression pillars, we deliver an independent, explicitly scoped, zero-floating-point verification companion for its discrete algebraic, symbolic dual-number bilinearization, tight-support, tagged-permutation, harmonic-star, and tripod AM-HM rigidity mechanisms. Layer 1 (OpenAIOmegaLowerBound.lean) proves 18 standalone constructive Lean 4.35.0 algebraic, combinatorial, and rational-rigidity sub-lemmas (zero sorry, zero axiom, zero Classical.choice, zero warnings; 4 zero-axiom none and 14 [propext, Quot.sound]). Layer 2 (OMEGA94-LB-CERT-1.0) is a pure-stdlib Python int/Fraction 4-mode auditor certifying 16 canonical finite witnesses in 0.027-2.466 ms and rejecting 70/70 live adversarial forgeries with exact branch assertions (76/76 pytest checks).
